title: Install Manifests Well-Known Index
description: v1 — Publisher-hosted index of install-manifest URLs. A publisher hosts this JSON at a kind-specific discovery location (github raw, https /.well-known/, or atproto PDS record). A federated registry crawls each publisher in its allowlist, fetches this index, and resolves the listed manifest_urls to canonical install-manifests. The contract is: registries do not need a publish API; publishers do not need a registry account. Discovery is one-way HTTP fetch against a maintainer-curated publishers.json allowlist.

version.description: Version of THIS index schema. Pinned. Future index schemas bump.

publisher.description: Who is publishing this index. Identity kind determines how the registry verifies ownership of the discovery location.

kind.description: Identity kind. 'github' = owner/repo on github.com (ownership proven implicitly by repo write access). 'https' = a domain the publisher controls (ownership proven by DNS TXT record OR a maintainer-issued challenge file at /.well-known/toolspace-challenge.txt). 'atproto' = a DID on the AT Protocol network (ownership proven by signed PDS record at lexicon app.toolspace.installManifests).

id.description: Kind-specific identifier. For 'github': '<owner>/<repo>' (e.g. 'oaustegard/muninn-utilities'). For 'https': a bare hostname (e.g. 'muninn.example.com'). For 'atproto': a DID (e.g. 'did:plc:abc123...' or 'did:web:example.com'). Per-kind regex pattern enforced via the top-level allOf.

display_name.description: Human-readable name surfaced in the registry UI. Same cap as install-manifest's tool.name.

homepage.description: Optional canonical URL for the publisher. Repo page, project site, or about page.

contact.description: Optional contact address for the registry maintainer to reach the publisher (broken links, schema migrations, security).

atproto_record_uri.description: Required when kind='atproto'. The at-uri of the PDS record holding the canonical signed copy of this index (e.g. 'at://did:plc:abc.../app.toolspace.installManifests/self'). Registries verify the at-uri's record matches the fetched index.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this index was generated. Registries use this to detect freshness; stale indexes can be quarantined.

manifests.description: Install-manifest URLs the publisher claims authorship of. Empty arrays are legal (a publisher temporarily without listed tools).

id.description: Globally unique tool id. MUST match the install-manifest's tool.id at manifest_url. Registries reject indexes whose declared id doesn't match the fetched manifest's tool.id.

manifest_url.description: URL to the install-manifest JSON document. SHOULD be a stable URL (commit-pinned for git hosts is best; main-branch raw is acceptable). MUST be fetchable by an anonymous HTTP client.

manifest_version.description: Declared install-manifest schema version of the document at manifest_url. Registries use this to fast-route validation. MUST match the manifest's actual manifest_version field. Enum extends as install-manifest schema versions ship.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'active' = current and supported. 'deprecated' = still works but the publisher recommends alternatives. 'broken' = publisher acknowledges the manifest_url 404s or fails validation. 'quarantined' = registry-set, surfaced back here as a hint; publishers SHOULD set 'broken' for self-acknowledged issues.

summary.description: Optional. One-sentence description, intended to mirror the install-manifest's tool.summary. Lets registries surface meaningful list views without fetching every manifest. Same 280-char cap as install-manifest's tool.summary.

tags.description: Optional. Capability tags. Intended to mirror the install-manifest's tool.tags; same 16-item cap, same lowercase-hyphen pattern. Lets registries filter without per-manifest fetches.

deprecated_in_favor_of.description: Optional. Required-when-status='deprecated' (enforced via top-level allOf). Tool id the publisher recommends instead. Registries MAY surface as a 'see also' link.

allOf.title: publisher.id pattern by kind
allOf.description: Each identity kind constrains the shape of publisher.id. github = '<owner>/<repo>' with the GitHub-allowed character set. https = a bare hostname (no scheme, no path). atproto = a DID matching did:plc:|did:web: with the spec-allowed character set.
